name: B10-0175/2025 (The Left) – Severe political, humanitarian and human rights crisis in Sudan, in particular the sexual violence and child rape
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the severe political, humanitarian and human rights crisis in Sudan, in particular the sexual violence and child rape
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for an end to the war in Sudan and to the widespread sexual violence against women and children. It asks all countries to stop sending weapons to Sudan and to hold those who break the existing Darfur arms embargo accountable. It wants the European Union to give more money for humanitarian aid and for care of rape survivors, and to stop sending Sudanese people back to danger.

- The Parliament asks for a United Nations arms embargo across all of Sudan.
- It wants more European Union aid and support for survivors of sexual violence.
- It urges European Union countries to stop returning Sudanese nationals and open safe routes.
